_meta.purpose: Caller-supplied acronyms that outrank the governed catalog, in two layers so that last-wins layering can be tested.
_meta.shape: "layers" holds one mapping per layer; each mapping is exactly what GovernedDictionary(custom=...), with_custom(...) or a verb's custom= argument accepts, so a value is either a bare long-form string or a full GovernedEntry object. "layer_order" gives the order to apply them in: later layers win.
_meta.entry_id_prefix: LOCAL-, deliberately not NDS-, so provenance shows at a glance that the answer did not come from the catalog.

WLT.notes: Full entry form. The catalog has no WLT row, so this overrides nothing and carries its own provenance and confidence.

DEP.notes: Full entry form, and a direct contradiction: the catalog pins DEP to Deposit for this domain and this overlay pins it back to the catalog-wide default.

WLT.notes: Same token as the house_style layer, applied later, so this is the one that must win.

_exercises.ID: Bare string, and an override of a governed entry: the catalog pins ID to Identifier and this says Identity. Under allow_override=true the answer is Identity with source=custom. Under allow_override=false the custom value is refused, the answer stays Identifier, and the result has to say that an override was declined.
_exercises.DEP: Full entry object, and an override of a domain pin. Same allow_override split as ID, with an entry_id and a confidence below 1.0 to prove the overlay's own provenance is carried through rather than the catalog's.
_exercises.TXN: Bare string, and an override of an approved abbreviation. Present in the second layer only, so it also shows that a layer may introduce an override the first layer never mentioned.
_exercises.KYC: Bare string, and a token the catalog does not have at all: it is in dictionary.json's reserved_absent list. Overriding nothing is not an override, so it must be applied even under allow_override=false. Defined in both layers with different long forms, so last-wins layering is observable on it.
_exercises.WLT: Full entry object for a token the catalog does not have. Defined in both layers with different canonicals, entry_ids and confidences, so a layering test can check that the whole entry is replaced and not merged field by field.
_exercises._layering: Applying house_style then project_local must give: ID -> Identity, DEP -> Department, TXN -> Transaction Record, KYC -> Know Your Counterparty, WLT -> Wallet Account (LOCAL-WLT-0002). Applying them in the opposite order must give KYC -> Know Your Customer and WLT -> Wallet (LOCAL-WLT-0001), which is how a test tells composition from set union.
